Clozapine is antipsychotic medication that is used in treatment of schizophrenia

  • It work by antagonizing serotonin receptors, dopamine receptors , it also antagonizes muscarinic receptors and alpha adrenergic receptors
  • Here we will talk about 3 most serious side effects of this medication

Agranulocytosis

  • Agranulocytosis is severe decrease in granulocyte count in the blood, granulocytes are neutrophils, basophils and eosinophils which are white blood cells,
  • Granulocytes are related to immune system and fighting infections
  • Once there numbers decrease this lead to increase liability to infections , Symptoms include fever, rigors, sore throat, pneumonia , UTI and sepsis
  • It is caused by bone marrow suppression done by the clozapine , this occurs in 1% of people taking clozapine
  • Risk factors for developing agranulocytosis while taking clozapine include: old age, female gender, concurrent treatment with medications that lead to the same condition
  • Agranulocytosis maybe fatal

GIT hypomotility

  • GIT hypomotility is decreased contractile forces or slower transit of the gi tract
  • This occur due to the antimuscarinic effects of the clozapine
  • This will lead to constipation, fecal impaction, paralytic ileus , bowel obstruction , acute megacolon, ischemia or necrosis
  • This is also might be fatal

Myocarditis

  • Inflammation of the heart muscle , in 3 % of cases
  • Myocarditis symptoms include chest pain, fatigue, edema , arrhtymias SOB
  • Risk factors include rapid titration of the drug, concurrent use of SSRIs , illicit substance abuse

Hypersalivation

  • Not a serious side effects
  • Most common , occur in 60% of patients, because clozapine is agonist in M4 which is highly expressed in salivary glands

Clozapine also lead to weight gain and high blood sugar because of serotonin antagonism

  • It may lead to postural hypotension and palpitation due to blocking of alpha adrenergic receptors
  • Clozapine also lead to elevated temperature , sedation, and urinary retention due to its anticholinergic effects
